svg.aria-label: Heirloom — releases a vault on Base to your heir once your wallet goes quiet across chains. The card's violet stamps stop; a stranger's $0 row is refused; silence outlasts grace; the oxblood RELEASED stamp lands.
svg.text: A dead-man's switch for a self-custody wallet.
It reads silence across chains: no keeper, no button.
